ClientCodexLocalization.text: Quick and lethal. This Scaldra unit has been trained to rush the target and inflict maximum damage with their curved blades.
Specialized Scaldra demoltions unit, with an impressive vocal range.
This automated aerial unit tracks and triangulates its target with lasers and then fires a high caliber rifle shot.
This armored personnel carrier is designed to move Scaldra forces quickly and easily around Höllvania. Its roof mounted turret provides lethal defense.
This support unit smokes out its target with gas grenades and finishes the job with blows from his massive club.
This rifle unit has been trained to suppress the enemy with volley after volley of machine gun fire.
Even redundant technology is given new life through the Technocyte Virus.
The rapid decay of human ingenuity produces daemons. Often found growing on neglected Hell-Scrubbers.
These tiny nodules of Techrot are the diabolic union of an arc welder and a gas can. Usually attacking in groups, they explode as soon as they near their target.
Once a simple workstation, the servant has turned against its former masters.
This agressive melee unit dashes at enemies, lashing out with frenzied strikes.
This self-sacrificing unit ignites its subsumed propane tank and then charges its prey, for the survival of the Hive.
This tottering, bulbous Techrot creation can inflate bladders to become airborne, raining down destruction on those below.
This heavily armored, slow moving unit lays down the law with dual Efervon cannons.
Sporting a ballistic shield, this heavy unit closes the distance while laying down pistol fire. Carries an Efervon gel cannon.
A member of the infamous Grustrag Three

Summons Hyekka to aid her in battle.
A cunning combatant that uses machinery to assist him.
A resilient combatant who relishes pain.
Highly maneuverable combatant with devastating attacks.
Heals his team with advanced medical technology.
An experienced veteran, trained and disciplined.
A frontline warrior who protects his allies.

A lethal blend of Corpus ingenuity and Sentient technology, this MOA has been loaded up with devastating hybrid weaponry.
The unseemly marriage of a Corpus sentry turret and a Sentient drone, this unit alternates between repeating energy bolts and a devastating focused beam weapon.

Corpus Osprey and Armored Sentient, conjoined in a hideous fusion of known and unknown to create a lethal unit that attacks with conventional beam weapons, or clones nearby friendly units to create Spectralyst fighters.
A diabolical mess of limbs, this Amalgam fighter doesn’t care which way is up. A fast-galloping unit that attacks with crushing melee blows, a repeater cannon and destabilizing ground slams.

The full realization of the grotesque partnership between Alad V and the Sentients. This unit can upgrade organic allies by capturing them and birthing neuro-carnivorous memes directly into their brain stems, thereby super-charging their fighting capacity and resilience.

Alad V has married countless generations of Sentient evolution with the most advanced Corpus technology to create a brutal, persistent fighter. Wields a plasma bullet assault rifle and carries an Amalgam Osprey into battle.
A transient copy of an ally or enemy created by a Sentient from Tau energy.

An amalgamation of a Corpus Sniper and unknown sentient form. Not only is this fighter capable of pinpoint accuracy it can also manipulate matter to create a Spectralyst clone of any enemy, including Tenno.
Dropship or gunship? Retrofitted for the challenges of Gas City and designed to rapidly deploy force to any security breach.

Alad V has married countless generations of Sentient evolution with the most advanced Corpus technology to create a brutal, persistent fighter. Wields a razor-torch hot enough to melt Sentient armor and is capable of rapid regeneration.
The unseemly marriage of a Corpus sentry turret and Sentient drone, this unit alternates between Arca Plasmor blasts and a devastating focused beam weapon.

An amalgamation of a Corpus brute and unknown sentient form. Not only is this fighter capable of crushing blows it can also manipulate matter to create a Spectralyst clone of any enemy, including Tenno

A lethal blend of Corpus ingenuity and Sentient technology, this MOA shares the out-of-phase healing mode with its Prototype cousin but is also capable of staggering opponents with globes of explosive Sentient energy.
A diabolical mess of limbs, this Amalgam fighter doesn’t care which way is up. A fast-galloping unit that attacks with crushing melee blows, destabilizing ground slams and homing energy projectiles.
Nimble and relentless, the Aquila is the staple dogfighter of the Corpus fleet.
A high-ranking Corpus official who is armed with a powerful cryo beam and deploys Cryo Sentries.
Specialist boarding unit, armed with an impact-hammer capable of rapidly disabling critical ship systems.
Specialist boarding unit trained to wreak havoc on crew and equipment with his proximity-grenade launcher.
Specialist boarding unit, armed with repeat scatter blaster for shredding enemy personnel.
Elite Corpus robot. Launches tether-mines to ensnare opponents. Kinetic gun blasts have a strong knockback effect. Deploys defensive Aurax Moas to shield itself.
Trained to fly Crewships and armed with a laser pistol.
An elite unit that shocks and staggers with snares from his Protonex snare.
Wields a devastating rotary laser cannon. Trained to clear entire hot zones with deadly efficiency.
Raknoid robotic unit upgraded with a thorax-mounted missile launcher.
Elite robotic walker, armed with a high-intensity thermal beam.
Elite robotic walker, armed with twin heat-sapping cryo beams.
Trained in the art of deflection, this elite melee fighter uses his high-discharge staff to block most incoming, forward fire.
Carries countermeasures that interfere with hacking.

These greedy little Murmur tricksters love to steal Conduit Dockets and other coveted items from Albrecht's labs.

The victim and beneficiary of Parvos Granum's research into Specter Particle Theory, this is all that remains of the Protea Warframe who sacrificed herself to keep Granum safe in a pocket realm beyond time.
A carrion-eater and opportunistic bird-of-prey. Condrocs gather, feed upon carrion and, occasionally, hunt in groups known as ‘committees'. Several committees will be led by an Emperor.
Grineer mobile defense platform. Pneumatic groundpounders, high-drop entrances and wide-bore cannons deliver the same simple message: boom.
The largest version of the Grineer mobile defense platform. Pneumatic groundpounders, high-drop entrances and wide-bore cannons deliver the same simple message: boom.
An upsized version of the Grineer mobile defense platform. Pneumatic groundpounders, high-drop entrances and wide-bore cannons deliver the same simple message: boom.

An avian of ridiculous appearance found along coastal regions and around large bodies of water. Mergoo circle and squawk at the sight of marine predators. Many an Ostron fisher owes their life to these odd little birds. Killing one is considered very bad luck.

The Vasca strain is a symbiotic blood-borne virus transmitted via the saliva of infected Kavats. Existing solely to propagate itself the virus makes the host increasingly dependent upon the ingestion of blood, thereby spreading itself further and faster through the population. Vasca-infected kavats, over time, lose all sense of themselves becoming increasingly cunning, violent and ravenous.

An ancient brute possessed of a weighty arm-flail and the terrifying strength to use it to devastating effect. Its lumbering form belies shocking speed, which the Leaping Thrasher achieves by slamming its arm into the ground and throwing itself into battle.
One of Parvos' favored, keeper of the tokens of his esteem.
Touched by the hand of Arlo they come to spread his healing word. Rejoice.
Attacking with blade and gun, this Zealot spreads the ‘message' with a hive of toxic, explosive pustules that grow on his back when he is attacked.
This Zealot targets potential converts with a spray of toxic sludge.
From Arlo the promise of a new life, a new form and a new word: death.
Launches slow-moving, high-charged orbs of electricity.

A specialist in synthetic metallurgy protected by a large shield wall. This Corpus Tech brandishes a razor-torch hot enough to melt Sentient armor and is capable of rapid regeneration. Summons a Mine Osprey.
Spawned the body of a creature killed by infested, these charges are fast with weak claw attacks.
The Arbiters of Hexis created this drone to put Tenno to the test in Arbitrations.
He came in search of Void treasure, the Orokin Neural Sentry had other plans.
Using the latest in Corpus weapons technology, this Crewman absorbs damage, until it unleashes it all in a powerful shockwave. The Derivator unit is mounted on the back.
Demolishers are explosive enemies with a single-minded purpose: the destruction of compromised conduits at any cost. Part of the complete Alad V Conduit Security Package!
Reinforced Condor used to transport elite personnel into conflict zone.
Aerial transport that delivers Corpus Reinforcements to strategic locations.
In and out under extreme duress, the Firbolg handles lightning-fast infiltrations/extractions and lazy picket duty with equal aplomb.
Identifies potential threats and calls in reinforcements.
A long-range battery that fires destructive ordnance.
Fires armor-shattering shells at a rapid rate.
Retrofitted for Plains operations, the Tusk-variant Ogma IDs targets at range, hammers out missile volleys on approach and finishes the job with a rain of explosives.
This Bombard's portable, back-mounted mortar allows the Grineer to rain destruction anywhere on the plains.
Hardy and quick-thinking, as formidable outside his Dargyn as in.
One of the faceless Grineer ranks.
Fires a devastating heat ray and self destructs.
A rugged career pilot, bred to survive on the Plains.
Armed with a high-velocity rapid-fire cannon, this armored skiff tears up targets and terrain alike.
Agile and quick-witted, as patient as she is cunning.
A Grineer device meant to lure in Vomvalyst and trap their energy.
Carries an impenetrable shield and fires grenades.

The pride of the Tusk fleet, the Bolkor is the ideal platform from which to mount ground operations. Equipped with a high capacity rotary cannon, densely plated and with enough space to carry a platoon, the Bolkor holds its own raining down fire and dropping squad after squad at regular intervals.
Oversees the tasks performed by other drudges.
Proficient with tools used for smelting.
Proficient with tools used for grinding.

The Worm Queen's early presence aboard the Zariman has aided her troops' defenses. Through Reliquary tampering, The Worm Queen has bestowed these troopers with a miniature Kuva Trokar to disrupt transference.
Heavy melee unit that protects allies with Overguard, or damage reduction if Tenno
An Infested jetpack trooper, the Undying Flyer rams opponents at high speed. When killed it reverts to a pod-state. If not destroyed the Undying Flyer emerges at full health.
Highly mobile and heavily armored, this unit spreads mayhem with his modified Tonkor.
A timid rodent that is easily frightened.
The finest Bailiff clones are chosen to serve in the Queen’s Fortress.
Compact robots that hunt with relentless zeal.
Swings a Jat Kittag as he runs down his foes.
Brings devastation with a modified Ogris.
Assailing enemies with the Twin Basolk, this combatant closes in on its target with teleportation technology.
Leads a pack of Hyekka into battle.
These mobile infantry make up the core of the Nightwatch Corps.
Sporting the visceral Ripkas, this unit is a specialist in close quarter combat.
Distracts prey with rollers while taking aim with a high-calibre Marelok.
Blocks hostile gunfire with a reinforced Brunt.
These massive Sentients emit pulses that disable machinery, and deploy lesser Sentients that help to boost the pulse field. They have recently learned to disable Warframes.
Energy released when an Errant Specter is defeated. Used to charge the Xoris glaive.
The ghostly minions of Parvos Granum within his timeless prison-realm.

"Known and unknowable. This thing has haunted my life, waking and asleep, ever since I made that accursed bargain. A parasite at the core of my city. It drains my wealth, my power, my reactors… and my dignity.

This will not stand. I will see that horrendous thing destroyed.

I will be free."

Alad V
A support unit can heal fellow Sentients. Canisters located near this units center of mass appear weaker than the surrounding carapace.
Flying unit that can swoop down into melee.
A high-order Sentient that bifurcates its body, creating a portal it uses to summon reinforcements and projectiles. Armed with twin cannons.
These ethereal Sentients attack with both a sonic barrage and a thunderous homing orb.
A fledgling Battalyst deployed before it had a chance to fully develop.
This lightweight Sentient mounts itself to solid ground in order to deploy massive long range cannons.
Frontline shock trooper that uses its large shield arm to block incoming damage.
An officer who can disable Perception-affecting abilities from Warframes.
An officer who can disable Damaging abilities from Warframes.
An officer who can disable Supporting and Debilitating abilities from Warframes.
An officer who can disable Mobility abilities from Warframes.
A common employee of the Corpus Armada.
A security specialist who is deployed in response to high-level threats.
Engages a field that disables Warframe powers.
A crewman specialized in long-ranged firearms.
A specialist who dispatches a Shield Osprey when threatened.
A specialist Crewman who wields a massive torque-wrench.
A Moa equipped with a modified Dera rifle.
A Moa equipped with a Disc Launcher.
A Moa equipped with Twin Rocket Launchers.
A Moa equipped with a modified Glaxion rifle.
Lobs explosive orbs that detonate after several seconds.
Charges a target and self-destructs when threatened.
Recharges the shields of nearby allies.
Facilitates weapon testing for the Jackal.
A massive, lumbering, brute of an Eidolon.
An ancient Eidolon, searching for its lost brethren. Trying to make itself whole.
The energy contained within this Eidolon is powerful enough to alter the local weather system.
A seasoned combatant specializing in sub-zero warfare.
A lost soul. Part energy, part physical shell, these Sentient remnants seem to have a symbiotic relationship with the much larger Eidolons.
A subordinate loyal to the Zealoid Prelate, the Bastion renders regular Infested invulnerable.
Wreathed in an obfuscating black cloud the Zealoid Prelate brings Arlo's word with fire, blood and loyal Bastions who spring to his aid.
Broken out of the Saturn Six Max-Pen by the Wolf, this fugitive is a loyal member of his pack.
The only lunatic fearsome enough to have escaped the Saturn Six Max-Pen.

Often found cocooned on the walls of the Zariman, the Void Angels were once human-like manifestations of people who died in the aftermath of the Zariman disaster. Over time they succumbed to the Void's song, and transformed into these angel-like creatures. They do not like to be disturbed.
An Entrati maintenance drone carrying a phial of corrosive solution, to top up laboratory devices.
This mocking phantom emerges to persecute the one who unwisely looked into its book, cutting deeply with hatred and blows alike. The book it arose from is its one vulnerability.

Looking too deeply into Albrecht's lost grimoires may cause a void-born duplicate to appear, seething with contempt for the one who let it loose and hurling its wrath from afar. It cannot be banished until the book that gave rise to it is destroyed.
This lumbering fragment, unconcerned with self-preservation, is liable to rupture violently when in proximity to its target.
In its calcified chaos, the Indifference is disjointed even from itself.
These sundered limbs have only partly fused. Lumbering, mindless horror is the result.

On the rare occasions when Murmur fragments assemble themselves into a whole, the result is a monstrous and potent entity. It may manifest in three different forms, the Suzerain, Zelator and Anchorite, with a fourth form, the 'Fragmented One', being the most formidable of all. Together, as heralds of the Indifference, they tether down the Strands of Khra down which their bizarre master must travel.
Clings to the cliffs and walls, hurling masonry on anything unfortunate enough to be traveling below.
An Infested beast of considerable strength long rumored to be lying dormant in the muck off the shores of Cetus.
Albrecht's Notes - We End as we Began
Anna Ki is a Punk Rocker
We Are Not What We Were
A Tide of Claws and Flesh
Fast with claw and missile attacks
This reborn Ambulas has been upgraded to become one of most lethal combat proxies.
Toxic to the core, Nox lobs exploding poison goo at enemies. Rupture his helmet to expose his head but beware of the unleashed noxious gasses.
Corrals its prey for rapid destruction
Charges its target and detonates when threatened
Voltage grenades detonate to create an electric field
Armed with a highly accurate laser cannon
Armed with a Mining Laser and Explosive Launcher
Follows a target while attacking them with lasers
Energy orb pulses AoE damage after detonation

Vay Hek's personal favorite, the Devourer is a maximal terror unit. Draped in shreds of the diapause bag that birthed it, this gap-mawed monstrosity barrels toward prey with furious intensity.

Wrist-mounted hooks are welded to elbow joints and hyperpowered by a myotechnological winch system for maximum impact-and-pull.

Known colloquially as the 'drill sergeant', the Auger is fast-grown into its enhancements. As with all Ghouls, no regard is given to the proper development of its higher functions.

Cantilevered leg augments propel the unit toward the fray at speed, while over- and under-mounted extendable drill carriages magnify both reach and penetrating power.
Whether through aberrant cognition or sheer brutality one specimen always moves to the front of each pack. It is from this individual that the other units take their lead.

The Expired are Ghouls who have succumbed to malnutrition or environmental poisoning during the early stages of development. Their backup nervous systems continue to drive them forward, however, making them ideal suicide troops.
So named for its terrifying leer, the Rictus (AKA 'the Sawman') lives to divide and conquer its foes - literally.
This specimen shows evidence of advanced cognitive abilities and greater, if rudimentary, situational analysis. Cold blooded and ruthless, it is easy to see how this specimen led its pack so ably.
Charges its target and detonates when threatened

Locks opponents in a tractor field preventing escape

Inflicts moderate damage at a fast rate
Emits a tractor beam, slowing its target down
Boosts Grineer morale while weakening enemies
Watches over the Tomb of Inaros.
Awoken by the Protector to help defend the Tomb of Inaros.
Charging attacks with a Power Drain and HUD Scrambling Aura
Heavy AoE attacks with a Heat Resistance Aura
Long range attacks with Shield Recharge Aura
Strong Melee attacks with a Slow Aura
Spawns maggots that attack its target
Heavy melee unit with a disrupting attack
Heavy melee unit that heals allies with pulses.
Riddled with boils that erupt into spawn pods when hit
Generates a coldness that reduces shields
Creates a field that lowers gravity
Shocks nearby enemies with a bio-electrical attack
Discharges tar-like mucus slowing its prey
Releases a poison cloud on death
Fast and explodes when near enemies
Heavy melee unit that lashes out with a toxic flail.
Lethal melee unit with ranged harpoon attack
Attacks any target hostile to the Lynx
Energy shield blocks projectiles and nullifies powers
Blocks choke points to protect objectives
Small and agile, jumps onto its prey
Collects fallen items on the battlefield
Weak, but aggressive with a high rate of fire

The cunning Therid uses its long arms to spin a ball of corrosive gossamer that it hurls with surprising force. It has also been known to scoop up smaller infested to throw at intruders as an improvised projectile/delivery system.
Carnis are many-legged hunters, ferocious and ever-hungry. They scuttle just out of reach trying to wear down their prey with ranged attacks until they can rush in to consume it.
The Carnis Rex is a true terror, a monstrously-large Carnis. The Carnis Rex rushes headlong upon their prey, often coiling into a spinning wheel in its haste to come to grips.
A writhing tower of flesh and gristle, the Jugulus lurks beneath the surface and emerges to launch streams of organic projectiles from its wide maw.
Saxum Rex are larger, meaner Saxum and represent a considerably enhanced threat. How they achieve this evolution is unknown, but cannibalism is suspected.
Marooned Corpus researcher, unwilling resident on Deimos and ally-of-circumstance to the Entrati. Happy to see a non-Infested face.
With the ability to track a scent from miles away, this Juggernaut is an invaluable ally when foraging rare Polyps from the ruins of Deimos

Genetrix act as mobile wombs for the Infested hordes, discharging swarms of Infested whenever they detect a non-Infested intruder. A Genetrix prominent sensor stalk must be disabled or avoided to stem a seemingly unending tide of monsters.
An evasive Vulpaphyla that prefers to run away from fights. Its skills are so profound it can even impart them to their master.

This hardy creature has a collagenous dermis that acts as a thick, protective armor.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.

Tactically infectious, this Vulpaphyla weakens enemies to future attacks by inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Status Effects.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
Saxum are bipedal, medium-sized assailants capable of short-ranged attacks and a powerful ground slam in melee.
A sluggish highlands insect that’s capable of bursts of speed when threatened.
The fastest variety of Velocipod, it tends to favor the swamplands.
This large arthropod is generally found flying around Deimos’ several grottos.
The most abundant variety of Cryptilex, this aggressive insect will slash anything it deems a threat.
The most dangerous Cryptilex. They have glands in their abdomens that can emit an acidic spray.
This infectious insect is capable of hazardous viral attacks when alerted.
A prehistoric bird-like creature that often congregates in small groups.

The rarest of Avichaeas, the Viscid produces a thick, tar-like mucus that it discharges when imperiled.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.

This capricious avian unleashes swarms of infested spores as its primary defense mechanism.

Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.

Unlike most of the highly aggressive life on Deimos, the Vizier Predasite prefers to avoid direct conflict and will instead disable foes from afar. A pack creature, it sheds restorative spores to aid those it considers kin.
A strong and highly aggressive subspecies that can engage groups of enemies with its <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral jaws and incapacitating spores.
The Pharaoh Predasite prefers to leave as much of the fighting to its master as possible, empowering their master's weapons while making enemies more vulnerable to attacks.
An infested drone as brutal and unforgiving as Deimos itself.
Wily Grineer castaway, acclaimed as squad leader by his surviving brood-mates. Capable of complex diplomatic negotiations by Grineer standards.
A distinctly Deimosian grotesquerie that attacks its opponents from above.
Due to its remarkable strength, this Nexifera can cause seismic shocks when hitting the ground.
The Viridian Nexifera can produce a cloud of poisonous gas that’s always best avoided.
When pressured, this beast severs its torso from its legs, yielding double trouble for its victims.
Fiercely territorial, this beast lurks within the ruins of Deimos.
Deaf, dumb, and blind, it hunts prey using vibrations from the surrounding environment.
Deaf, dumb, and blind, it hunts prey using vibrations from the surrounding environment.
Dismembered, but deadly nonetheless. Its acrobatic movement makes it threatening from any range.
Dismembered, but deadly nonetheless. Its acrobatic movement makes it threatening from any range.
A shy, bizarre-looking, semi-aquatic creature that seldom attacks unless provoked.

The Howler is easily startled. Its penetrating scream will cause other, more dangerous animals to investigate.

Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.

The Vaporous Undazoa gets its name from the noxious gas it belches out when alerted.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
The Unseeing Herald proclaims the will of the Indifference, uttering its twisted desires in Voidtongue. Who among us has heard its whispers?

This Kuva Lich has sworn it's loyalty to Ryoku.
Worm-like constructs clad in Orokin gold, these Golden Maw's burrow into the ground, emerging to ambush foes and devour them.
This Sister of Parvos has sworn their loyalty to Vena.
The Golden Maw attaches to the brainstem of the host, putting them completely under the control of the Maw.
An Infested jetpack trooper, the Undying Flyer rams opponents at high speed. When killed it reverts to a pod-state. If not destroyed the Undying Flyer emerges at full health.
The crystalized remains of the master foundry operator, Belric.
The crystalized remains of the celebrated Void engineer, Rania.
The Narmer Veil is in full control.
Under the control of the Narmer.
A spiderlike robot produced by Narmer converts from the Corpus, and used as a veil transmission relay.
Director of the Subterranean Armaments Division. Responsible for all research into weapons that can more effectively combat all things fungal.
A Bursa unit that corrals its prey for rapid destruction.
A large Raknoid, with multiple attack vectors that is most frequently deployed during high alert levels.
Director of the Subterranean Demolitions Division. Responsible for carving out swathes of Venus's mines for Nef Anyo's personal use.
Director of the Subterranean Strike Division. Responsible for coordinating attacks on targets that draw Nef Anyo's ire.
A seasoned combatant specializing in subterranean warfare.
An attack drone that deploys a heat-based aerosol before pummeling targets.
This unit deploys an energy field that blocks projectiles and nullifies powers.
A hybrid air-ground unit, armed with a Tetra rifle and a devastating visor mounted beam weapon.
An Osprey that recharges the shields of it's allies.
An elite combatant that controls the battlefield through a combination of teleportation and decoy deployment.
An attack drone that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Deploys a heat-based aerosol before pummeling targets from range with energy shells.
A unit that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy, wields dual ice-picks and possess a flying charge attack. Explodes upon death.
A diminutive Raknoid that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Occasionally lays explosive mushrooms.
A Moa unit that has been exposed to the to energy of the Syzygy. Capable of creating a powerful shockwave by stomping it's foot.
A Bursa unit that has been exposed to the power of the Syzygy. Corrals its prey for rapid destruction.
A unit that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Deploys turrets and fires deadly shots from afar using it's laser cannon.
A seasoned combatant that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Engages targets with quick strikes from it's shock baton.
A quick-moving unit that closes the distance with it's target through a battering shield, before striking with it's hammer.
Chief technology officer of the Subterranean Research Division. Responsible for researching Syzygy energy to the benefit of Nef Anyo.
A quick-moving Moa, armed with a laser disc weapon.
A large hatchet and flying charge attacks make this heavy unit a capable foe.
Dual ice-picks and flying charge attacks make this light unit a capable foe.
A diminutive Raknoid that can close large distances with it's jumping attacks.
This mid-sized Raknoid spits immobilizing fluid from it's sac before latching onto prey with it's grappling hook.
A Moa unit that fires from range while laying mines.
A seasoned combatant that utilizes multiple grenade types to deal heavy damage.
A Moa unit capable of creating a powerful shockwave by stomping it's foot.
A shotgun wielding combatant specializing in subterranean warfare.
A unit that deploys turrets and fires deadly shots from afar using it's laser cannon.
Chief research officer of the Subterranean Energy Division. Responsible for producing new methods of energy production to fuel Nef Anyo's ambitions.
Available from Son in the Necralisk, Master Teasonai in Cetus, and The Business in Fortuna.
A Grineer Captain specializing in thermal weaponry.
A Grineer Commander specializing in freezing weaponry.
A Grineer Commander specializing in electrical weaponry.
A Grineer Captain specializing in toxic weaponry.

The Stover is a kind of proto-Kubrow, resurrected as Venus thawed. When grouped in a pack Stovers are relentless opponents.

Sleek and silky, the adorable appearance of the Venusian Virmink belies its aggressive demeanor. Favoring rocky landscapes Virmink packs nose the air, scenting for Pobbers - their primary food source.

Found near bodies of water the Horrasque subsists primarily upon fish. This hideous creature is terrible to behold, but will not attack unless provoked. When it does its roar will shake the bowels of even the most steadfast trapper.

Native to the fungal forests of Venus, the Pobber is a skittish rodent possessed of an objectionable odor. Always found in groups they flee at the slightest hint of trouble. They are a primary food source for Virmink and Sawgaw.
